newsitem.title: USA: TIMES MIRROR COMPLETES CHANDLER TRUSTS DEAL.
newsitem.headline: TIMES MIRROR COMPLETES CHANDLER TRUSTS DEAL.

text.p: Times Mirror Co said Monday it completed its previously announced transaction with the Chandler Trusts.
The company said the transaction will reduce its outstanding series A common stock by 6 million shares and its outstanding 8 percent series A preferred stock by $367 million of stated value.

On Friday, Times Mirror announced an agreement in which it and the trusts will make equal contributions to form a limited liability company. Chandis Securities, a holding company principallly owned by one of the Chandler trusts, would then be merged into a subsidiary of Times Mirror.
